mentions.name: LSM tree database in Go
mentions.description: A database engine implementing an LSM tree in Go, built as a learning project to improve understanding of Go and database internals, with planned experiments using io_uring for disk operations to explore underlying OS functionality.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on building an LSM tree db in Go, to learn more about the language and improve my understanding of db internals.

Also planned to try out some io_uring based disk operation eventually, as an experiment to learn more of the underlying OS stuff.
